auth.description:
Registry authentication, delivered as OCHARTED_AUTH from a Secret. When neither
field is set the registry is anonymous — fine for cluster-internal
deployments; set one for anything exposed.

existingSecret.description: Use this existing Secret for OCHARTED_AUTH instead of rendering one.
existingSecret.title: existingSecret

users.description: Basic-auth users as a `user:password,user2:password2` list (OCHARTED_AUTH). If set, it is rendered into a chart-managed Secret. Leave empty and use `existingSecret` to supply it from your own (e.g. SOPS/sealed) Secret.
users.title: users

auth.title: auth

config.description: The proxy's configuration; every field maps to an OCHARTED_* env var.

allowPrivateUpstreams.description: Permit upstreams that resolve to private addresses (OCHARTED_ALLOW_PRIVATE_UPSTREAMS), e.g. an in-cluster ChartMuseum. Leave off otherwise.
allowPrivateUpstreams.title: allowPrivateUpstreams

cacheMaxBytes.description: In-memory derived-artifact cache bound in bytes (OCHARTED_CACHE_MAX_BYTES). Purely a latency/upstream-traffic optimization; size resources.limits.memory above it with headroom.
cacheMaxBytes.title: cacheMaxBytes

externalHost.description: Canonical client-facing hostname written into rewritten dependency URLs (OCHARTED_EXTERNAL_HOST). Host only — no scheme, no path. Static so rewritten bytes are identical no matter which hostname a client used.
externalHost.title: externalHost

indexStaleTTL.description: Stale-if-error bound (OCHARTED_INDEX_STALE_TTL): when re-fetching an expired index fails (network fault, upstream 5xx), the cached copy is served up to this age, so upstream outages delay freshness instead of failing Flux reconciles. Authoritative answers (404, allowlist rejection) are never masked. "0" disables.
indexStaleTTL.title: indexStaleTTL

indexTTL.description: Upstream index.yaml cache TTL (OCHARTED_INDEX_TTL) — how fast new chart versions appear, and how often upstreams are re-fetched.
indexTTL.title: indexTTL

logLevel.description: Log level (OCHARTED_LOG_LEVEL): debug, info, warn, or error.
logLevel.title: logLevel

maxChartBytes.description: Upstream chart tarball size cap in bytes (OCHARTED_MAX_CHART_BYTES).
maxChartBytes.title: maxChartBytes

maxIndexBytes.description: Upstream index.yaml size cap in bytes (OCHARTED_MAX_INDEX_BYTES); generous because real indexes get big (Bitnami's is tens of MB).
maxIndexBytes.title: maxIndexBytes

metricsEnabled.description: Expose Prometheus metrics at /metrics on metricsPort (OCHARTED_METRICS_ENABLED). Disabling removes the metrics listener, container port, Service port, and ServiceMonitor entirely; health probes are unaffected (they target the http port).
metricsEnabled.title: metricsEnabled

metricsPort.description: Metrics listen port (OCHARTED_METRICS_PORT), kept off the public registry port.
metricsPort.title: metricsPort

port.description: Registry API port (OCHARTED_PORT): /v2/, /healthz, /readyz; also the container/Service http port.
port.title: port

provenanceEnabled.description: Fetch each chart's .prov file and attach it as the Helm provenance layer when upstream publishes one (OCHARTED_PROVENANCE_ENABLED). Adds one upstream request per chart build.
provenanceEnabled.title: provenanceEnabled

resolveScanLimit.description: Max candidate versions a cold by-digest lookup derives before giving up (OCHARTED_RESOLVE_SCAN_LIMIT).
resolveScanLimit.title: resolveScanLimit

rewriteDependencies.description: Rewrite HTTP(S) dependency repository URLs inside served charts to point back through this proxy (OCHARTED_REWRITE_DEPENDENCIES), so `helm dependency update` also resolves through it. Requires `externalHost`; mutually exclusive with `provenanceEnabled`. Trade-off: rewritten charts no longer hash to the digest upstream's index publishes.
rewriteDependencies.title: rewriteDependencies

upstreamAllowlist.description: Upstream repo hosts that may be proxied, as glob patterns (OCHARTED_UPSTREAM_ALLOWLIST), e.g. ["*.github.io", "charts.jetstack.io"]. Empty allows any public host. This is an SSRF boundary as much as an abuse guard — set it on any deployment reachable by untrusted clients.
upstreamAllowlist.title: upstreamAllowlist

config.title: config

deploymentAnnotations.description: Annotations added to the Deployment metadata, e.g. `reloader.stakater.com/auto: "true"` to roll the pod when a referenced Secret changes (recommended when using `auth.existingSecret`).
deploymentAnnotations.title: deploymentAnnotations

env.description: Extra environment variables as a map (templated).
env.title: env

envFrom.description: Sources of environment variables (templated), e.g. `- secretRef: { name: ocharted-auth }`.
envFrom.title: envFrom

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables as a raw list (templated), e.g. valueFrom a Secret key.
extraEnv.title: extraEnv

fullnameOverride.description: Override the generated name used for every resource's `metadata.name` (the chart "fullname").
fullnameOverride.title: fullnameOverride

global.description: Global values are values that can be accessed from any chart or subchart by exactly the same name.
global.title: global

digest.description: Pin the image by digest (sha256:…); set by the release pipeline. When set, it overrides the tag.
digest.title: digest

tag.description: Overrides the image tag; defaults to the chart appVersion.
tag.title: tag

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for private registries.
imagePullSecrets.title: imagePullSecrets

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe. Targets /healthz on the main http port.
livenessProbe.title: livenessProbe

enabled.description: Create a Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor (requires its CRDs and `config.metricsEnabled`).
enabled.title: enabled

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in the `app.kubernetes.io/name` label.
nameOverride.title: nameOverride

podAnnotations.description: Annotations added to the pod. A `checksum/secret` annotation is added automatically when the chart manages the auth Secret, so credential edits roll the pod.
podAnnotations.title: podAnnotations

enabled.description: Create a PodDisruptionBudget (meaningful only with replicaCount > 1).
enabled.title: enabled

podSecurityContext.description: Pod-level securityContext. ocharted runs as the image's nonroot user (uid 65532); no host or elevated access is needed.
podSecurityContext.title: podSecurityContext

priorityClassName.description: PriorityClass for the pod (templated); empty uses the cluster default.
priorityClassName.title: priorityClassName

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe. Targets /readyz on the main http port.
readinessProbe.title: readinessProbe

replicaCount.description: Number of replicas. ocharted is stateless and replicas re-derive identical answers, so >1 is just more capacity/HA — no coordination, no sticky sessions.
replicaCount.title: replicaCount

resources.description: Container resource requests/limits. If you set a memory limit, keep it comfortably above `config.cacheMaxBytes`.
resources.title: resources

securityContext.description: Container securityContext. Drops all capabilities, read-only root filesystem, no privilege escalation.
securityContext.title: securityContext

externalTrafficPolicy.description: externalTrafficPolicy (only applied when type is not ClusterIP).
externalTrafficPolicy.title: externalTrafficPolicy

automount.description: Mount the API token. ocharted never calls the Kubernetes API, so this is off by default.
automount.title: automount

name.description: ServiceAccount name; empty uses the chart fullname.
name.title: name

signing.description:
Cosign signing of served artifacts. When enabled, every manifest gets a
signature under cosign's sha256-<digest>.sig tag convention, which Flux
enforces via `verify.provider: cosign`. The signature attests the path
(these bytes came through this ocharted), not upstream authorship.

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret holding a PEM-encoded Ed25519 private key (PKCS#8, e.g. `openssl genpkey -algorithm ed25519`). Ed25519 only — its deterministic signatures are what keep replicas stateless. Empty disables signing. The chart never manages this Secret: private key material belongs in your own (e.g. SOPS/sealed) Secret. NOTE: ocharted reads the key once at startup, so rotating it requires a pod roll — e.g. set `reloader.stakater.com/auto` via `deploymentAnnotations`.
existingSecret.title: existingSecret

existingSecretKey.description: Key in `existingSecret` holding the private key PEM.
existingSecretKey.title: existingSecretKey

signing.title: signing

startupProbe.description: Startup probe (GET /healthz on the main http port, so it works regardless of the metrics toggle).
startupProbe.title: startupProbe

strategy.description: Deployment update strategy. RollingUpdate by default; ocharted is stateless so a surge-then-drain rollout is safe.
strategy.title: strategy

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Grace period for a clean shutdown (drain).
terminationGracePeriodSeconds.title: terminationGracePeriodSeconds

repository.description: `helm test` connection-pod image; a gcr-mirrored curl, so the test never pulls from Docker Hub.
repository.title: repository

volumeMounts.description: Additional volume mounts on the container (templated).
volumeMounts.title: volumeMounts
